cases.expected: Exactly one Prisma-generated additive api_key_config migration replays from Phase009; earlier tables/data/migration bytes stay unchanged. ApiKeyConfig has the exact fields/indexes, full unique lowercase fingerprint, bounded canonical padded-base64/JCS envelope with exact column bindings, nonnegative revision, consistent revocation timestamps, immutable identity/provider/ciphertext and irreversible REVOKED lifecycle. Name/status changes alone increment revision; malformed/duplicate/unknown/oversize/column-mismatched envelopes and invalid state transitions are rejected. Generate/status/drift/type checks pass.

On an explicitly marked disposable development/test PostgreSQL17 database, the real db:seed CLI creates exactly one normalized ADMIN/ACTIVE, three frozen internal SystemConfig defaults and same-transaction append-only creation audits. bcryptjs cost12 verifies the CSPRNG password without persisting plaintext. Seed provenance has a stable nonsecret seedRunId/source marker and an administrator-row fingerprint. Missing/invalid input, ambiguous target, migration drift and audit failure exit nonzero without credential/URL disclosure or partial writes.

The same seed input creates/updates zero administrator/config/audit rows on repetition. Password hash, creation timestamps, role/status/sessionVersion/revision and every config value remain identical. Only the matching previously seeded administrator and fingerprint count as replay; changed password, email, source marker, fingerprint, privilege/status or config content is rejected without mutation.

Two independent real seed CLI processes from the same initially empty fixture produce one administrator, one row per key and one audit per creation. Serializable/unique conflicts use only three fixed bounded retries, re-read and validate all existing content; exhausted conflicts get one read-only reconciliation and never silently succeed with missing or conflicting rows. No partial or duplicate rows remain.

Missing variables, invalid email, weak/overlong password, production/unknown environment, unowned database, pre-existing USER, DISABLED admin, unproven admin and conflicting config fail closed with no changes. Schema/migration/seed/output/evidence contain no generated password, provider-key pattern or encryptedKey value; raw stdout/stderr scans precede safe archival. Isolated create-only-to-update and removed-production-guard mutations turn the original assertions red with actual nonzero exits; restored tests pass. Audit failure rolls back every business write.

The migration and base seed create zero ApiKeyConfig rows and no Prompt/Model/Provider/AiOutputRecord governance tables or records. No temporary governance models or parallel secret fields exist. All Phase006-009 domain/schema/audit regressions, the full product quality commands, exact evidence/hash/failure-chain checks and independent Agent review pass for M2 closure.

decisions: Only Phase010 and the M2 data-layer gate are authorized; Phase011 remains unexecuted and nextPhaseExecutionAuthorized=false.

Extend the existing audit transaction enrollment with a CLI-owned real Prisma connection and Serializable isolation. Caller-supplied transaction wrappers remain forbidden. A completely validated no-op aborts a read-only transaction using a private sentinel, so the existing no-audit-no-commit guard is preserved.

Keep User/SystemConfig schema intact. Append-only SEED_ADMIN_CREATE/SEED_CONFIG_CREATE audits hold the stable source marker, disposable-run identity and SHA-256 of the persisted administrator row including its bcrypt hash. Validate source plus current fingerprint and bcrypt comparison; never persist a direct password digest or account credential in evidence.

Three internal GENERAL config keys are planner.quick.defaultDurationDays=3, planner.quick.defaultTravelerCount=1 and planner.quick.defaultPace=moderate. Existing equal values remain untouched; conflicting values/group/public exposure fail closed. Environment deployment ceilings precede database configuration; governance defaults belong to Phase015.

Read only NODE_ENV/DATABASE_URL and command-scoped ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD through env-cli. Seed requires development/test, exact loopback disposable naming plus matching database comment, PostgreSQL17, bounded URL options, non-owner/non-superuser runtime role and exact applied migration checksums before business reads/writes.

Use a new task-owned labeled PostgreSQL17 tmpfs container with isolated networking, CSPRNG synthetic credentials and separate migration/runtime roles. Persist credentials only under ignored .scaffold; no provider adapter credential or key row is created by migration/seed.

JCS envelope fields are ASCII-only fixed literals/hex/base64, allowing an exact canonical SQL reconstruction. Shared TypeScript parser/fingerprint/AAD functions define the same Phase013 boundary; actual provider adapters, management APIs and rotation remain later work.
Extend earlier integration target guards and table inventories solely to test the new Phase010 disposable database. Preserve historical migrations, Gate bytes and all original domain assertions.
notApplicable: No production database, real identities, provider requests, encryption/rotation management API, authentication session or future governance implementation is exercised.
